messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — Severity: S2. Model quality regression detected for tenant AcmeCorp (tenant_id: acme-123) on dedicated pool `dedicated-eu-west-3`. Metric: ROUGE-1 dropped from ~14% to ~6% for model `open-7b-q4` after quantization-profile `qprofile-v2` rollout. Trigger at 2026-03-15T09:02:25Z. Please ack and triage.

sre-anna: Acked. I'm on it. @eng-ml-rajesh can you confirm whether qprofile-v2 was rolled to tenant-scoped variant or pool-wide?

eng-ml-rajesh: I see the rollout was applied to tenant-scoped config for acme-123 at 09:01:40Z. This looks like a precision/regression in the LLM outputs after the int4 path. Short answer: qprofile-v2 introduced a quant kernel combo that reduced generation quality on long-context prompts we use in Acme's promptset.

sre-anna: Ok — immediate impact assessment: are we seeing increased errors or just degraded quality? Any customer-visible failures?

eng-ml-rajesh: No elevated error rates. Latency/throughput unaffected. It's purely quality regression (semantic hallucinations and dropped entities). I've pulled a few logs and eval snippets:

```
--- sample comparison ---
input: "Summarize the invoice and highlight missing line items"
open-7b-fp16: "Invoice shows 4 items. Missing: tax line."
open-7b-q4 (qprofile-v2): "Invoice incomplete. Some items gone."
ROUGE-1: 0.140 -> 0.062
```

eng-runtime-miguel: If it's tenant-scoped, we can rollback for acme-123 only. I can trigger a revert of the quant profile for that tenant and route them back to `open-7b-fp16` variant while leaving others on qprofile-v2.

prod-contact-kate (AcmeCorp): We're seeing customers report bad summaries in production — some contracts got garbled. This is high impact for us. ETA to mitigation?

eng-runtime-miguel: Starting tenant-level rollback now. Running command:

```
# revert tenant quant profile and route variant
redwoodctl tenant update --tenant acme-123 \
  --set quant_profile=qprofile-v1 \
  --route-default-model=open-7b-fp16 \
  --pool dedicated-eu-west-3
```

deploy-bot: rollback job 98765 started for tenant acme-123 on pool dedicated-eu-west-3. Job queued on infra nodes: node-12,node-13.

sre-anna: Good. After rollback we'll need to flush KV/prefix caches for that tenant so cached low-quality tokens don't persist. @eng-runtime-miguel can you include a KV flush step? Also open a mitigation incident ticket.

eng-runtime-miguel: Adding KV flush:

```
redwoodctl cache flush --tenant acme-123 --scope prefix
```

deploy-bot: rollback job 98765: step1(revert-config) completed, step2(route) completed, step3(cache-flush) running.

customer-success-jordan: I'll set up a quick call with Kate to explain and send status updates. Kate — do you want rollback only, or do you want us to run a targeted re-eval on your production prompts once rollback is live?

prod-contact-kate (AcmeCorp): Please rollback now and then run targeted re-eval. We'll want confirmation before we reenable qprofile-v2 for our tenant.

sre-anna: Plan recap (immediate):
- rollback tenant quant profile to `qprofile-v1`
- route default model to `open-7b-fp16` for acme-123
- flush tenant KV/prefix cache
- run smoke eval on sampled production prompts (5-10)
- monitor ROUGE/Self-checks for 30 min

eng-ml-rajesh: I'll prepare the eval promptset and run local sims once the route change propagates. If we confirm improvement we keep rollback and schedule deeper root-cause; if not, escalate to model-retraining/backport.

oncall-next: I'm taking over monitoring in 30m. @sre-anna if you need longer handoff I'll stay on.

deploy-bot: rollback job 98765: step3(cache-flush) completed, step4(post-smoke-eval) running.

eng-ml-rajesh: Smoke eval results (first pass):
```
samples: 8
open-7b-fp16 (post-rollback) ROUGE-1 median: 0.138
open-7b-q4 (pre-rollback) ROUGE-1 median: 0.061
improvement observed across all sample prompts
```

sre-anna: Great — quality back to expected range. Miguel, leave traffic routing in rollback state for now. We'll not reapply qprofile-v2 for acme-123 until we have a patch or different kernel combo.

prod-contact-kate (AcmeCorp): Thanks. Please confirm when all traffic is on the fp16 path so we can resume normal ops. Also request postmortem and timeline for permanent fix.

customer-success-jordan: Noted — sending customer update now and scheduling a 1:1 postmortem with Kate for tomorrow. 

sre-anna: Opening internal incident: INC-2026-0321-acme-quantregress. Assigning to eng-ml for RCA. Will include logs, rollout diff, and kernel trace.

eng-ml-rajesh: For RCA I'll need the kernel selection trace + quant calibration dumps for qprofile-v2. Miguel, can you attach node logs from node-12/node-13 to the ticket?

eng-runtime-miguel: Attaching logs now. Also flagged the qprofile release: rollout batch id 2026-0315-qv2. I'll lock the rollout window until the RCA is complete.

deploy-bot: rollback job 98765: COMPLETED at 2026-03-15T09:18:15Z. Traffic for acme-123 on `open-7b-fp16`.

sre-anna: Closing immediate on-call work. Monitoring for 30m. oncall-next will maintain watch and escalate to eng-ml if any regression reappears. Jordan — please share the customer update summary in #customer-updates when done.

customer-success-jordan: Sent update: "We rolled back a quantization change that degraded summary quality. Engineering is investigating; rollback in place and monitoring. Will follow up with root cause and timeline." Kate acknowledged.

prod-contact-kate (AcmeCorp): Acknowledged. Appreciate the quick response.

sre-anna: Handoff notes for oncall-next: incident id, rollback job id 98765, logs attached to INC ticket, watch ROUGE-1 and hallucination alerts, escalate to eng-ml if ROUGE < 0.10. Handoff time 09:20Z.

oncall-next: Taking over monitoring. If anything new shows up I'll ping the group and escalate. Good handoff.

sre-anna: Filing postmortem owner assignment to eng-ml-rajesh. Expecting RCA draft in 48h and remediation plan (either quant profile fix or opt-out path) in 1 week.

eng-ml-rajesh: Working on RCA. Preliminary hypothesis: qprofile-v2's per-channel scale quantization interacts poorly with attention norm for certain invoice-style prompts. Will test a conservative calibration and alternative kernel mapping.

sre-anna: Thanks team. Closing thread for now; will reopen if monitoring flags any regression. :white_check_mark:
